findings.source_quote: By this time, the strong agricultural society of the Mennonites had transformed Ukraine into a breadbasket, its vast fields sown with wheat developed specifically by the Mennonites: Turkey Red Wheat.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the crop name into Swedish or supply an accepted Swedish rendering immediately following the English name in parentheses. For example: "...vete utvecklat särskilt av mennoniterna: Turkey Red-vete (Turkey Red Wheat)." Preserve the surrounding HTML and sentence structure.
findings.translation_quote: Vid denna tid hade det starka jordbrukssamhället bland mennoniterna förvandlat Ukraina till en kornbod, dess vida fält sådda med vete utvecklat särskilt av mennoniterna: Turkey Red Wheat.

findings.source_quote: This hardy crop had made the Mennonite church quite wealthy, and their colonies had grown and flourished into villages of comfort and, at times, extravagance.
findings.suggested_fix: Ensure consistent and correct spelling of the group name in Swedish. Use 'mennoniterna' for the people and 'mennonitkyrkan' (with double 'n') for the church where appropriate. Example correction in the paragraph: replace 'menonitkyrkan' with 'mennonitkyrkan'. Preserve HTML tags and sentence order.
findings.translation_quote: Denna härdiga gröda hade gjort menonitkyrkan ganska rik, och deras kolonier hade växt och blomstrat till byar av bekvämlighet och ibland överdådighet.

findings.source_quote: Religious services were rarely allowed, and the agricultural communities that had fed Russia and many others besides were collectivized and put under government control.

findings.translation_quote: Religösa gudstjänster tilläts sällan, och de jordbrukssamhällen som hade fött Ryssland och många andra blev kollektiviserade och sattes under statlig kontroll.
